lines.quote: Trump promised to lower gas prices. When are they coming?

lines.quote: they remain stubbornly high. For consumers, it's meant pain at the pump
lines.subject: ms-now (on consumers)

lines.quote: Trump says he'd make the same choice to go to war with Iran again

lit: go to war with Iran again
lines.why: It reports the speaker's own stated stance on his past decision, which is a record of loyalty rather than a reading of the war.

lines.quote: UAE SECRETLY Helping Houthis WAR On Saudis
lines.subject: Breaking Points (on the UAE and Houthis)
lines.why: It concerns a Yemen-Saudi conflict rather than the US-Iran war, so it gives no reading on the object.

lines.quote: Bibi seems to have narrowly avoided outright defeat
lines.subject: Breaking Points (on Netanyahu)
lines.why: It describes an Israeli election result and a leader's standing, not a reading of the US war.

lines.quote: WAR With Iran LOOMS
lines.subject: Breaking Points
lines.why: It frames a new war with Iran as coming, which runs against the no-war promise.

lines.quote: US-Israel Strikes on Iran Could Come in Early November
lines.subject: Steven Cook (Council on Foreign Relations, as aired)
lines.why: It forecasts US-Israel strikes on Iran in early November, a forecast of the war that would frustrate the no-war promise.

lines.quote: Netanyahu Gains Ground in Uncertain Israel Election
lines.subject: Ethan Bronner (as aired)
lines.why: It reports a foreign election outcome for a leader, which is not a reading of the object.

lines.quote: the outcome of the vote has implications for the regional conflict with Iran

lit: implications for the regional conflict with Iran
lines.why: It says an Israeli election bears on the Iran conflict without giving any reading of how the war has treated US audiences.

lines.quote: Are GCC countries looking for a regional security pact with Iran?
lines.subject: Al Jazeera

lines.quote: Iran is using the threat of spy networks to detain and execute political opponents
lines.subject: Iran's government
lit: using the threat of spy networks
lines.why: The line describes Iran's internal repression, which is a frame about the enemy rather than a reading of how the war served American voters.

lines.quote: Trump's EPA is lowering costs
lines.subject: Trump's EPA (Lee Zeldin)
lines.why: The speaker claims an energy-rule mechanism lowers costs and adds oil supply, a claim that leans toward delivery for consumers though it is a proposal and not the war itself.

lines.quote: inflation has accelerated in the past couple of months as the Iran war has caused spikes in oil and gas prices
lines.subject: the Federal Reserve and the Iran war (as reported by NPR-PBS)
lit: the Iran war has caused spikes in oil and gas prices
lines.why: The line says the war drove up fuel and inflation, which frustrated the cost-of-living interest of the audience.

lines.quote: Mike Collins drops Election Day gas price prediction

Democrats' path runs through Trump Country

suspected plot targeting a base used by the United States

lines.quote: citing $45B in savings

lines.quote: after US bombers pulled
